verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents activity logging onto contact records: calls with recordings and transcripts, emails logged automatically against the right contact and deal, and campaign engagement flowing back to the contact. Its API exposes people, companies and activities as entities. However, the evidence never explicitly shows contacts linked to companies, a unified timeline view, or activity history on company records. Missing for 10: documented contact-to-company record linking, an explicit full activity timeline view, activity history on company records, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Every call is logged on the record with its recording and transcript
every customer email is logged against the right contact and deal automatically
with engagement flowing back onto the contact record
